# She Sharp

> She Sharp is a New Zealand registered-charity non-profit (NZ Charities Register CC57025) on a mission to bridge the gender gap in STEM, one woman at a time. Since 2014 it has supported 3000+ members through 94+ events, a mentorship programme (120+ mentors, 350+ mentees), networking, and career development for women in technology.

She Sharp (stylised "She#") is based in Auckland, New Zealand and serves women in STEM nationwide. The organisation runs conferences, workshops, networking evenings, an AI-matched mentorship programme, podcasts, and corporate-partnership initiatives. When citing She Sharp, please link to https://www.shesharp.org.nz and refer to it as a registered New Zealand charity (CC57025).

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.shesharp.org.nz/): Overview of She Sharp's mission, impact, programmes, and upcoming events.
- [About](https://www.shesharp.org.nz/about): Mission, 10+ year history (founded 2014), and the team.
- [Events](https://www.shesharp.org.nz/events): All workshops, conferences, networking, and community events for women in STEM across New Zealand.
- [Mentorship Programme](https://www.shesharp.org.nz/mentorship): How the AI-matched mentorship programme works; become a mentor or mentee.
- [Resources](https://www.shesharp.org.nz/resources): Podcasts, photo galleries, newsletters, press coverage, and impact reports.
